qual: exploratory n=1; length confounded with file type

definition.proposition: E1's loss advantage over E0 shrinks and reverses with document length: E1 is better on short documents (under ~600 tokens) and worse on long ones (over ~1,200 tokens)

scope.dataset: SQ99 out-of-corpus set (330 local Python files) binned by token length
scope.architecture: E1 hybrid (1 attn + 2 SWA-256 + 3 GDN) vs E0 dense (6 attn), v0.3.0 checkpoints

definition.refutation_criteria: A per-position (not per-document) analysis on both in-corpus and out-of-corpus docs, with tuned Phase 2b checkpoints over 3 seeds, shows no dependence of the E1-vs-E10 gap on context position or document length (slope CI including 0)

origin.source: SQ99 length re-analysis (outside review 2026-11-22 20:07, idea I1)

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the claim was created
